visual_records.analytical_purpose: Freeze the state variables before drawing the organization.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 1 defines personnel, job types, total staff, middle managers, ability, growth limit, threshold, and churn rate.
visual_records.next_action: Release a machine-readable symbol and unit dictionary.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the initial population and replacement rule visible.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 1 splits management and executive layers, prioritizes manager and staff positions, and makes the 370-position graph replaceable.
visual_records.next_action: Publish the graph, priority list, and vacancy semantics.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Connect the staffing diagram to Department Network edges.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 2 shows one leader and six subordinates in a typical department and connects parent and child departments.
visual_records.next_action: Release node identities and promotion-path direction.

visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 uses the same seven staff to contrast undirected friendship, undirected message links, and directed leader-to-subordinate edges.
Figure 4 stacks four layers over the same staff and routes four effects plus occupation dissatisfaction into personnel situation.
visual_records.next_action: Retain layer alignment and index definitions.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Bind promotion timing to a fixed parameter table.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 2 lists thresholds and annual ability growth for AC, IE, EE, IS, ES, JM, and SM.
visual_records.next_action: Release threshold units and alternative growth scenarios.

visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 places demission, promotion, transfer, recruitment, and settlement between month start and month end.
visual_records.next_action: Release executable event ordering and tie rules.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Read busy seasons and equilibrium before using the steady-state equation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 6 shows recruitment and resignation oscillations with total personnel moving down then stabilizing around 285-295.
visual_records.next_action: Report seeds, intervals, and formal convergence criteria.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate direct ability and indirect network effects.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 7 routes ability through five adverse indexes into staff productivity and then sums staff productivity to organization productivity.
visual_records.next_action: Calibrate the proxy against observed productivity.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Tie a visual trend to the direct/indirect explanation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 8 shows ability rising, productivity stabilizing around 600-700, and average demission index increasing toward a steady stage.
visual_records.next_action: Release raw series and uncertainty bands.

visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 9 contains three two-year simulations with monthly vacancies and recruiting cost spikes, including a December hiring peak.
visual_records.next_action: Release random seeds, costs, and vacancy denominators.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate structural stability from random recruitment variation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 10 shows similar position-cost ratios across three simulations, supporting the paper's stable-training-cost reading.
visual_records.next_action: Compare training outcomes under changed position mixes.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the forecast categories and units inspectable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 3 reports recruiting, salary, training, and total costs for three data sets; totals are close but not identical.
visual_records.next_action: Release source costs and forecast-error checks.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn parameter change into the 80% occupancy decision.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 11 places 18%, 25%, and 35% staffing curves near theoretical steady values, with higher churn producing lower occupancy.
visual_records.next_action: Report sensitivity ranges and decision tolerance.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Keep cost savings separate from manpower harm.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 4 shows recruitment cost rising while salary/training fall as churn rises, alongside vacancy and five-index values.
visual_records.next_action: Report units, scenario definitions, and uncertainty.

visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 12 shows a gradual total-staff decline, promotions/transfers, and a growing leader-vacancy gap when external recruitment is forbidden.
visual_records.next_action: Test alternative promotion and recruitment policies.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Bind the stress conclusion to one final-month snapshot.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 5 records resignations, promotions, transfers, nine leader vacancies, total staff, productivity, and five effect indexes in the final month.
visual_records.next_action: Release the full monthly trajectory and policy counterfactuals.
